origin: Arsène awakens as Joker's first Persona during his confrontation with Kamoshida's Shadow. Faced with the choice of submitting to Kamoshida or resisting him, Joker embraces his rebellious will and summons Arsène.

Zorro awakens when Morgana fully commits himself to the Phantom Thieves and confronts the Shadow representing the distorted authority of Kamoshida's Palace. His resolve to fight alongside the others manifests as Zorro.
Captain Kidd awakens when Ryuji confronts the Shadow Kamoshida and rejects the role that Kamoshida forced upon him. By accepting his anger and choosing to rebel, Ryuji calls forth Captain Kidd.
Carmen awakens when Ann stops allowing Kamoshida and the people around her to define her worth. When she chooses to stand against him and protect Shiho, Ann's determination manifests as Carmen.

Goemon awakens when Yusuke confronts Madarame and recognizes the betrayal behind his relationship with his former master. Yusuke accepts his own desire to expose Madarame's crimes, giving form to his rebellion through Goemon.

Johanna awakens when Makoto finally rejects the expectations imposed on her by the adults around her. After deciding to act for herself and stand against the injustice surrounding Kamoshida's and the school's students, her resolve manifests as Johanna.

Necronomicon is Futaba's Persona, awakened inside her Palace when she confronts the guilt and distorted memories surrounding her mother's death. By accepting that she was not responsible for her mother's death and choosing to face the truth, Futaba's resolve takes form as Necronomicon.

Milady awakens when Haru finally decides to resist the future that her father and his company have chosen for her. During the confrontation in Okumura's Palace, she accepts her own will and becomes determined to fight for herself, awakening Milady.

Robin Hood is Akechi's original Persona and represents the heroic identity he presents as the Detective Prince. In Royal, Akechi's relationship with his Personas is deliberately different from the other Phantom Thieves, and Robin Hood is part of the identity he chooses to present to the world.

Cendrillon awakens as Kasumi's Persona when she accepts her desire to move forward and fight alongside the Phantom Thieves. Her awakening is tied to the conflict surrounding her identity and the pressure she places on herself to live up to the ideal she believes her sister represented.
